name: zutil_zrdr_str_cmp_predicate
description: zUtil_ZRDR_StrCmpPredicate reports predicate success for exact matching non-null strings and nonzero for null or mismatched strings.
known_limits: Binary Ninja cannot lift the mismatch sbb flag sequence at 0x4a5dd7, so the reconstruction marker remains limited; assembly evidence validates strcmp-equivalent signed result behavior.
tier_s_evidence: VC5SP3 cl 11.00.7022 x86 /O2 /Ob0 /Zp4 /FAcs COFF byte comparison for @zUtil_ZRDR_StrCmpPredicate@8 at 0x4a5da0 passed with zero unmasked mismatches; Binary Ninja body is 71 bytes and the VC object symbol is 80 bytes with 9 trailing VC NOP bytes trimmed.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a5da0 validates fastcall ECX=str1 and EDX=str2, null input returning 1, bytewise exact string comparison, equal strings returning 0, and mismatch return formed from the carry flag sequence used by strcmp.

Native smoke zreader_archive_list_and_search_paths_smoke verifies zUtil_ZRDR_StrCmpPredicate returns 0 for the matching search-path payload and that zArchiveList_FindPayloadByPredicate_Thunk finds the matching payload through the zero-is-match convention.
